Hero_Desc_Hilde:
A long-standing resident at Monatium University Hospital.
She frowned upon the use of magic that could instantaneously heal illnesses with a mere utterance of spells, but after coming to Elias, she stopped being stubborn and focused on the Elias medical research method.
Her psychological treatments are especially in demand because of her kind and gentle nature.
Album_Like_Hilde: Real patients who are really sick.
Album_Hate_Hilde: Patients who demand counseling sessions after they miss their appointment.
Album_Hobby_Hilde: Playing party games with fake patients.
Album_Wish_Hilde: Regaining her honor in a magic-less world.
Album_Hilde1: Hilde is a senior resident at Elena University Hospital, located in uptown Monatium. She's known for receiving everyone as her patient. Elias denizens often visit her hospital when they get bored, requesting to be hospitalized.
Album_Hilde2: Hilde even accepts patients obviously faking illnesses without any examination. I initially thought she was a fraud, blinded by money, but she doesn't charge the patients anything. She said, all medical services in Monatium are free.
Album_Hilde3: When I asked why she doesn't at least pretend to treat them, Hilde explained that medical care is meaningless in Elias since everyone recovers naturally overnight or a few days. She said that with a lifeless face.
Album_Hilde4: Hilde once mentioned she has a bad history with Elena, the mayor of Monatium. Apparently, she's stuck as a resident doctor because of a bizarre competition law that Elena enforced: only Elena herself is allowed to use the title "Doctor".
Album_Hilde5: One time, Hilde joked about a patient who came in just to eat hospital food endlessly. The patient ran away from home, so she let her stay out of pity. She complained about how bad the food was yet kept eating it. Eventually, she nearly emptied the hospital's entire food warehouse, and Hilde had no choice but to kick her out.
Album_Hilde6: Most elves hate werebeasts for disrupting their city, but Hilde actually likes them. She finds it cute when they come to her hospital with small injuries from the forest. She even gives them a candy when she bandages them up.
Album_Hilde7: Unlike other elves, Hilde is not afraid of humans. She says humans conquered elves with ease, so there must be something worth learning from them. She often asks me about Earth's culture since she's never seen anything beyond the prison camp.
LoveHero_Hilde: Elias needs medical advancements too, doesn't it?
LoveHeroCancel_Hilde: So the Master also neglects medicine...
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Hate1: Hilde pondered a long while whether to eat it, muttering that such food shouldn't be made if health is considered.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Hate2: Hilde worried if she really understood what the hospital meant by 'consume plenty of minerals'.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like1: Hilde described the food as having the familiar taste of a home-cooked meal. Although not the best in flavor, it's packed with nutrients.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like2: Mentioning that it was a balanced meal, Hilde liked it more than expected. She wished there were more similar dishes.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like3: Hilde wouldn't dislike this. She called it an essential nutritional supplement for picky eaters in Elias.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like4: Hilde was amazed it was made to resemble the original. She praised that it wouldn't have been easy to replicate here in Elias.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like5: Hilde mentioned it seemed like a nutritionally balanced meal and would be beneficial if eaten while growing up.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like6: Hilde mentioned that even though it's important to stay healthy, indulging in such a snack once a year is permissible.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like7: Despite being a bit high in calories it is rich in nutrients, that's why Hilde seems to recommend it to everyone around her.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like8: Hilde said experts didn't have a positive opinion about eating sweets. When I asked if she wouldn't eat it, she gently started picking up the Almond Pralines.
Food_ChefNote_Hilde_Like9: After tasting the candy, Hilde became curious about the ingredients and asked for many samples. Though, it seemed more like an excuse given her joyful demeanor.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Hilde: I'm the chief resident at Monatium University Hospital
Gacha_Result_Line1_Hilde:
Hehe. Are you ready
for your treatment?
Hilde_Growth2: I do not know whether I will ever have occasion to use this ability, but...
Hilde_Victory1: Aren't you lucky I'm here? Hehe...
Hilde_Victory2: I treated as best I could.
Hilde_Defeat1: You're not too hurt, so... you should be fine.
Hilde_Defeat2: You can't expect a doctor to fight, can you?
Hilde_Affinity1_1: If you wanna pretend you're hurt it's fine. I'll treat you.
Hilde_Affinity1_2: Hand me that sick note. I'll stamp it for you.
Hilde_Affinity2: Did you come because you're really sick? Here, take a seat... let me take a look.
Hilde_Affinity1_3: You want me to apply that red stuff that stings like a mother?
Hilde_Affinity3: If you want to quickly get better, you need to get a lot of sunlight. Visit the hospital frequently too!
Hilde_Affinity4: Mayor, mayor... wherever I go, it's always about that mayor. Such an egomaniac.
Hilde_Affinity5: Hospital food doesn't taste good? It's because it's healthy.
Hilde_Affinity6: I wonder when the little patient with the bell around their neck will visit again? Such a cute kid.
Hilde_Affinity7: It seems there's a lot to learn from humans. Please teach me slowly, one at a time.
Hilde_Die1: It's a crime to attack a medic...
Hilde_Die2: I don't see anyone who can treat me...
Hilde_LevelUp: Nothing is more important than experience.
Hilde_Equipment: I always take good care of my equipment.
Hilde_HeroSkill: Technique is important too, but you shouldn't over-rely on it.
Hilde_HeroUpgrade: That sure cheered me up. Could I graduate from my residency too?
Hilde_Board: Pay a house call? Of course I can.
Hilde_DeckSetting1: Even with a doctor around, you still need to be careful, okay?
Hilde_DeckSetting2: If you get hurt, call for the medic!
Hilde_Touch1_1: Is this some kind of facial stimulation therapy...?
Hilde_Touch2: It feels good to be spoiled sometimes.
Hilde_DutchRubEnd2: Will you pay for my medical bills?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Hilde_Skin1: Although Hilde's dressed for a rare day off, it seems like this style perfectly suits her.
Hilde_Growth1_Skin1: I feel as refreshed as today's weather.
Hilde_LevelUp_Skin1: Spending time outside the hospital is also a worthwhile experience.
Hilde_Equipment_Skin1: I'm not carrying any heavy medical equipment, so my luggage is light.
Hilde_HeroSkill_Skin1: Now that I've had a breather, I can focus more at the hospital.
Hilde_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I have no problem going out alone now!
Hilde_Board_Skin1: The flowers over there are so pretty. Oh, here, too!
Hilde_Touch1_Skin1: Ugh, I even put on makeup for once...
Hilde_Touch1_1_Skin1: I was going to take a selfie, but you're making my face turn red!
Hilde_Touch1_2_Skin1: You're so mean to ruin my picnic, I was having a good time!
Hilde_Touch2_Skin1: A touch as gentle as the mountain breeze.
Hilde_Touch2_1_Skin1: My picnic has just become better.
Hilde_Touch2_2_Skin1: Be careful not to hurt your hand on my hairpins.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Hilde_Skin2: Even on vacation, Hilde's concern for her patients remains unchanged. If someone pretends to be ill, she fans them with her hat.
Hilde_Growth1_Skin2: I suppose it would be all right to rest for a little while.
Hilde_Growth2_Skin2: What a fresh day, just like the sea breeze.
Hilde_LevelUp_Skin2: I am glad I came on vacation!
Hilde_Equipment_Skin2: This outfit makes my heart feel lighter.
Hilde_HeroSkill_Skin2: Rest has a way of inspiring us.
Hilde_Board_Skin2: Where is the patient playing in the water? I will go.
Hilde_Touch1_Skin2: Huh? Is this... a cheek massage?
Hilde_Touch1_1_Skin2: If you pull like that... I cannot rest.
Hilde_Touch1_2_Skin2: The vacation... was not to your liking?
Hilde_Touch2_1_Skin2: Are you enjoying your vacation too, Master?
Hilde_Touch2_2_Skin2: I want to help you rest too, Master.
Hilde_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: You're going to ruin my hat!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Hilde_Skin3: Hilde fights tirelessly to drive out evil and restore peace. She leads everyone forward with fierce determination.
Hilde_Growth1_Skin3: I am confident in my ability to carry out missions in secret!
Hilde_Growth2_Skin3: Whatever hardship comes, I will resist to the very end!
Hilde_LevelUp_Skin3: I can do anything if it means saving the world.
Hilde_Equipment_Skin3: This is quite sophisticated equipment. I can wear it with confidence.
Hilde_HeroSkill_Skin3: The research I pursued with conviction is finally bearing fruit.
Hilde_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: I will continue to grow and lead everyone toward peace!
Hilde_Board_Skin3: Is this our stakeout spot? I will move right away.
Hilde_Touch1_Skin3: W-what are you doing? Is this some secret signal?
Hilde_Touch1_1_Skin3: Ngh, I will not simply endure this forever...!
Hilde_Touch1_2_Skin3: Mmm... I may be getting used to it now.
Hilde_Touch2_Skin3: I-it is a little flustering... but does not feel bad.
Hilde_Touch2_2_Skin3: Perhaps this is precisely the peace I wish for.
Hilde_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Are you saying you intend to become our enemy?!
Hilde_AsideGet: Ah, it's been a while since I took a break...
Hilde_AsideUpgrade: It feels like all my fatigue is gone.
Hilde_Ultimate2-01: Hah, ngh, ngh, ngh, ngh, ngaaah!
Hilde_Ultimate2-02: Hait! Hait! Tti, tti, tti, tti, ttiaah!
Hilde_Birthday: I heard it is your birthday. Make sure you enjoy it.
Hilde_Gacha2: Hehe, are you ready for your examination?
Hilde_Gacha3: I'm the chief resident at Monatium University Hospital
Hilde_Greeting: It is nice to meet you.
Hilde_Line1: Is there anyone who needs a wound treated?
Hilde_Line2: Eat and exercise regularly, avoid greasy and irritating foods... Where are you going?
Hilde_Line3: What brings you here? Where does it hurt?
Hilde_Lobby: Sigh, things have been far too quiet lately.
LoveLetter_Hilde: Hello, Master.The results from your recent checkup were not ideal. I trust you're not under the impression that being in Elias gives you the luxury of neglecting your health. It seems we'll need a follow-up exam. Please come by at your earliest convenience.Haha, just kidding. Your health results were excellent. You must be taking great care of yourself! Still, it's about time for another checkup, so please visit soon.Sincerely, Hilde
LoveCall_Hilde:
Hello, Master. This is Hilde. There is actually something I would like to ask of you.
Have you been struggling or worrying about anything lately, Master? Physically or emotionally.
If you have, could you tell me privately?

For some time, I have worried that perhaps you cannot easily open up even when something troubles you.
Most of Elias's residents rely on you, so I wondered whether you feel compelled always to appear as their steadfast support.

Of course, I do not consider that a bad thing. On the contrary, I am grateful.
But you need someone to rely upon as well, do you not?
So, Master, as Elias's only doctor, I will become someone you can depend on.
No matter how trivial the concern, whenever you need advice or wish to speak confidentially, please come to me.
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_001: Master, how about making a proper meal plan? And stop giving the Apostles whatever they want.
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_002: But if I feed them something they don't like, they complain.
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_003: I see... it must be tough for you. I think I understand. Even at the hospital, I hear complaints during meal times.
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_004: You all just have to eat whatever I make.
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_005: ...Isn't that just because you're too lazy?
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_006: But you eat only you want based on your preferences too.
Affinity_Hilde_EP01_007: Of course, everyone has preferences. However, to eat healthily, you need to eat things you don't like too.
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_001: I'm worried everyone's too carefree. I hope they can live a more balanced and healthy life.
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_002: I always told them to, but no one listens.
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_003: Everyone lives however they want, right? Make sure to take care of your health, Master.
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_004: If you have good genes, you can live healthily anyway.
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_005: Can you tell if you have good genes?
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_006: Why? It's easy anyway. Living recklessly is fun.
Affinity_Hilde_EP02_007: Because you're like this, everyone else is living without thinking?
Affinity_Hilde_EP03_001: The patients who come for treatment are all pretending to be sick. I wish there were more chance to treat real illnesses.
Affinity_Hilde_EP03_002: If there are fewer sick patients, isn't that a good thing?
Affinity_Hilde_EP03_004: It's because you keep accepting them. Don't overdo it.
Affinity_Hilde_EP03_005: *Sigh* I'm grateful for your words, but if I haven't accepted them, the hospital might really disappear.
Affinity_Hilde_EP03_006: Let's think of pretending to be sick as a kind of mental illness.
Affinity_Hilde_EP03_007: What do you mean? Mental illness means distorting reality and having trouble adjusting to society... Oh?
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_001: Humans' combat ability is surprisingly amazing. I never thought it's possible to suppress us with such primitive weapons...
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_002: It's not that we're amazing, maybe it's just you guys are lacking?
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_003: You speak like an elf, even though you're human.
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_004: That's not a good thing. Humans got the ability by fighting too often amongst themselves.
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_005: ...In that case, elves might be better.
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_006: Humans are naturally arch enemy of aliens.
Affinity_Hilde_EP04_007: Huh? How many races have you destroyed by now?
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_001: We have counseling programs at our hospital. Do you have any concerns you'd like to talk about?
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_002: How about a bloody debate about glasses preferences?
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_003: Is there really a debate over wearing glasses? Then you really need counseling.
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_004: I have the intense stress from running the Order.
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_005: That's a proof you're living hard. Come visit the hospital when you have time.
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_006: Right now, I'm the counseler. Don't try to switch roles.
Affinity_Hilde_EP05_007: You seem to be quite proud. But as a professional, I can say this is closer to a standing comedy.
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_001: Hmm... Master, you have a serious addiction to pinching cheeks.
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_002: What? Even if it were another human, they'd pinch cheeks as much as I do.
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_003: I guess that's a part of Earth's culture...
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_004: Hmph, funny. Pinching cheeks is the only way to prevent talking crap.
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_005: It seems quite serious... I have to find a way to force you into treatment soon...
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_006: I admit it. But it's your fault for making me this way.
Affinity_Hilde_EP06_007: ...First... the patients... shows a strong tendency to avoid responsibility...
Affinity_Hilde_EP07_001: Personally, I'm curious about the medical industry on Earth. Do you know anything?
Affinity_Hilde_EP07_002: I heard interns work without getting more than 3 hours of sleep a day.
Affinity_Hilde_EP07_004: Healers are tools. They don't have humanrights.
Affinity_Hilde_EP07_005: Doctors are treated like a tool... It's just as horrible as here.
Affinity_Hilde_EP07_006: I heard they have to endure fierce competition to become a doctor.
Affinity_Hilde_EP07_007: It's similar to us... But I think such trials are necessary for a job handling others' lives.
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_001: *Sigh* I was once a rival to Elena, but now I'm just an underling of hers who has to watch my step due to budget issues...
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_002: You should be thankful to be just an underling.
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_003: Anyway, it's impossible to harm others here. I don't know if I should be happy about it...
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_004: (Blinks eyes to send a Morse code signal. B-U-G-G-I-N-G)
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_005: Why are you blinking your eyes like that? If something is in there, I can take it out for you.
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_006: Don't cling too much to the past, it makes you seem weak.
Affinity_Hilde_EP08_007: What are you talking about all of a sudden?
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_001: Wouldn't it be more convenient to apply a reservation system to the Banquet Hall, like in a hospital?
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_002: But isn't it more fun not knowing who will show up?
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_003: Extemporally cook for a customer who extemporally showed up... You're quite confident, huh? If it pleases you...
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_004: I've been thinking about applying it.
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_005: Good to hear that. If you don't set times, there will be troublesome customers who arrive late or won't leave.
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_006: A reservation system in Elias? More than half will be no-shows.
Affinity_Hilde_EP09_007: That's such an accurate prediction I can't argue with it. I might be wrong.
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_001: I feel a bit reluctant to integrate magic into medical science. Am I being too stubborn about it?
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_002: You know, any sufficiently advanced medical science is...
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_003: Indistinguishable from magic... Don't say anything so lightly!
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_004: Is it due to your professional pride?
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_005: It's a bit different, but thanks for trying to understand.
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_006: When the environment changes, you have no choice but to adapt.
Affinity_Hilde_EP10_007: Humans call themselves adapting animals, right? I think that attitude is something to learn.
Affinity_Hilde_EP11_001: Hmm... I think I ate too quickly and got a bit of indigestion. Where did I put that emergency medicine...?
Affinity_Hilde_EP11_002: Here... let me kiss it better.
Affinity_Hilde_EP11_003: Huh? Hehe... It's been a while since I've been treated like a child. I don't hate it.
Affinity_Hilde_EP11_005: What is that? A folk remedy? Thanks, but no thanks.
Affinity_Hilde_EP11_006: Maybe you should head back to the hospital?
Affinity_Hilde_EP11_007: Ah, it was in my bag. Thank you.
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_001: We've had a lot more patients waiting at the hospital lately. What services would be helpful to provide for them while they wait?
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_002: How about having some classical music playing in the waiting area?
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_003: Um, are you trying to put all of our patients to sleep? That might not be too bad, actually...
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_004: How about handing out a few snacks?
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_005: Snacks aren't good for your health... and honestly, some patients might complain if the selection isn't to their taste.
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_006: How about providing some good reading material?
Affinity_Hilde_EP12_007: Health-related columns, magazines, research papers... And maybe even some picture books for the folks who dislike reading. Thank you.
Affinity_Hilde_EP13_001: I just thought of an old medical TV drama I used to enjoy. Did you like medical dramas, Master?
Affinity_Hilde_EP13_003: Hehe...! I can just picture the dramatic scene where the protagonist is carrying out a major surgery when you said that.
Affinity_Hilde_EP13_004: I watched that series about the doctor on the spectrum.
Affinity_Hilde_EP13_005: Oh, you know that series?! I'm so glad to have someone to geek out with about my favorite drama. Hehe.
Affinity_Hilde_EP13_006: No, I don't really care for them...
Affinity_Hilde_EP13_007: I see. Yeah, everyone's entitled to their own preferences.
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_001: More patients than I thought seem hesitant or fearful about coming to the hospital. What about you, Master?
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_002: I mean, those dental drills... they are quite scary.
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_003: Hmm... It is even scarier to be neglectful about cavities, you know...
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_004: If you're faking an illness, maybe not so much, but if you're actually suffering from something, it can definitely be scary.
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_005: Ah, then maybe it's best not to give painful treatments to patients who are just faking it. We wouldn't want to scare off all our patients...
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_006: I'm a strong one. I'm fine.
Affinity_Hilde_EP14_007: Really? Hehe... That sounds like a challenge... Let's see how you handle your next appointment!
Affinity_Hilde_EP15_002: Of course. You see these rock-solid muscles, don't you?
Affinity_Hilde_EP15_003: Hmm... not really... Do I need to get my eyes checked again...?
Affinity_Hilde_EP15_004: Do breathing exercises count as exercise?
Affinity_Hilde_EP15_005: Of course not. It's time you got into the habit of exercising regularly... for your own good, Master!
Affinity_Hilde_EP15_006: I'd like to exercise... but I don't have time.
Affinity_Hilde_EP15_007: Yeah, I understand where you're coming from. Maybe we could take a walk sometime and get some light exercise in once you have a bit of time?
Affinity_Hilde_EP16_001: Master, when was the last time you cleaned the banquet hall?
Affinity_Hilde_EP16_002: Er... um... a long, long, time ago?
Affinity_Hilde_EP16_003: Master! Keeping the kitchen is a must! Ugh... I just lost my appetite.
Affinity_Hilde_EP16_004: Just before I opened up the Banquet Hall today.
Affinity_Hilde_EP16_005: Wow, your hygiene standards are quite impressive. I can come over without any worries!
Affinity_Hilde_EP16_007: Hmm... It seems we'll need to start regular hygiene inspections of the banquet hall.
Affinity_Hilde_EP17_001: Oh! I suddenly want to see some of those adorable werebeasts! Do they visit the Banquet Hall often?
Affinity_Hilde_EP17_003: That's nice. I'll be able to run into them at the Banquet Hall later. Hehe.
Affinity_Hilde_EP17_004: They come by to hang out sometimes.
Affinity_Hilde_EP17_005: Aww! When you see them, please tell them I'm always waiting for them at the hospital.
Affinity_Hilde_EP17_006: No, they don't come around much these days.
Affinity_Hilde_EP17_007: Hmm... They haven't been visiting me much these days either... I guess that means they're healthy, so that's probably a good sign, right?
Affinity_Hilde_EP18_001: I'd like to treat you to something delicious someday, too, Master. What kind of food do you like?
Affinity_Hilde_EP18_003: Oh, that's a first! Many patients say that the food at the hospital is horrible. Hehe.
Affinity_Hilde_EP18_004: I miss food from back home sometimes...
Affinity_Hilde_EP18_005: You only realize the value of something once it's gone... I miss the food from that place sometimes, too.
Affinity_Hilde_EP18_006: Food with bold flavors... Spicy, salty, and sweet!
Affinity_Hilde_EP18_007: Master... there's no way you're skipping your next checkup.
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_001: I had such a busy day today. Having ten clones of myself wouldn't even have been enough to help... *Siiigh*...
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_002: What if you hired a junior resident?
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_003: How many elves in Elias do you think are actually interested in medicine, Master?
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_004: You could just stop the research, couldn't you?
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_005: I can't do that. My research isn't something that trivial and meaningless!
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_006: Is there anything I can help with?
Affinity_Hilde_EP19_007: Aww, you're so kind and thoughtful, Master. Thank you for offering. That alone is enough!
Affinity_Hilde_EP20_001: Sometimes I feel like Amelia is too wary of me. I wonder what goes on in her head to cause that...
Affinity_Hilde_EP20_003: Do you think so? It's not like I'm even that close with Elena... I don't understand.
Affinity_Hilde_EP20_004: Maybe it's because you're just so talented?
Affinity_Hilde_EP20_005: Hmm... Maybe it's connected to an inferiority complex, feelings of inadequacy, or a need for self-preservation? Anyway, thanks for the compliment. Hehe.
Affinity_Hilde_EP20_006: There's that idea that a strong rejection is just a strong acceptance in disguise...
Affinity_Hilde_EP20_007: What?! There's no way Amelia would be like that! She's pretty clear about her likes and dislikes...
